analysis: Batch 1.2 - the nine open orders 11-13 of the quasigroup laws have no model: 1076 at 11 and 12, 1110 at 12 and 13, 1279 at 12 and 13, 1286 at 12, 1313 at 11 and 12. 1,797 case CNFs, all UNSAT with drat-trim-verified DRAT proofs (206 million proof lines; hardest 812,068 conflicts, 1110 at 13); 0 UNKNOWN, 0 rejected. Controls: models found for 1110 and 1279 at order 11; all 21 known models at orders 11-13 (20 linear models over GF(11), GF(13) and the order-12 product for 1083) satisfy the CNF of their case. H-C05-I confirmed. 1,797 of the 1,823 case results were read from checkpoints written by earlier, interrupted runs of the same pipeline on the same (hash-identical) CNFs; a clean re-run without checkpoints (python -m lab verify EXP-C05-10, 2026-10-20, 61 minutes) reproduced the result hash exactly. The first decision control, 1083 at order 12, was replaced because its known model lies in the case of index 189 of 195.
assumptions: as EXP-C05-09; Latin columns by right_mul_bijective_of_law
orders with a linear model over GF(q) (EXP-C05-07) are members and are not re-decided
spectra are closed under direct products (any equational law)
falsification: A decision control without a model, a known model excluded by its case CNF, a rejected proof, or an UNKNOWN case.

hypothesis: H-C05-I: the case split decides every pair within 4 million conflicts per case; the decision controls 1110 and 1279 at order 11 have models, and every known model at orders 11-13 satisfies the CNF of its case.
methodology: Decide each pair with systems.magma_split.decide (cases of Lemma 8 in their fixed order, stop at the first verified model, otherwise every case refuted with a drat-trim-verified DRAT proof); 3 worker processes; per-case checkpoints (EXP_CHECKPOINT). Known-model controls with systems.magma_split.admits.
